ValidationRule.description: Requires a Digital EAA greater than 0 whenever Digital_BU__c is checked. Applies to every save except insert, so Lead conversion still succeeds. Skipped for users with the Bypass_Opportunity_Validation permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), NOT(ISNEW()), Digital_BU__c = TRUE, OR(ISBLANK(Digital_EAA__c), Digital_EAA__c <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a Digital EAA greater than 0 when Digital BU is checked.
